subject: english
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Lighting has

P. to become a disrupter and

Q. become human-centric as our

R. requirements change during the day and

S. lighting has to adapt to our change in needs
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "PQRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as it begins with 'Lighting has' and according to rules of grammar after has we need to use 'V3' or a 'direct infinitive (to+ v1)'. Among the given options 'direct infinitive (to+ v1)' is **'to become'**. It mentions lighting must evolve into a disruptor.
 
• Sentence Q is the second sentence as it begins with the verb 'become' because the previous sentence ends with 'and'. It mentions lighting must become a disruptor and human-centric. Thus, it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the noun '**requirements**' which is an extension of '**our**' of the previous sentence and mentions as our needs change throughout the day, lighting must change and become more human-centric.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence S is the last sentence as it begins with the gerund '**lighting**' and mentions lighting needs to change as our needs do.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

Lighting has

**P.** to become a disrupter and

**Q.** become human-centric as our

**R.** requirements change during the day and

**S.** lighting has to

 adapt to our change in needs
